# sendgrid_template (Resource)

Manages a SendGrid transactional template. A template's content is managed separately via one or more `sendgrid_template_version` resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_template" "welcome_email" {
  name       = "welcome_email"
  generation = "dynamic"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name for this transactional template. Does not need to be unique.

### Optional

- `generation` (String) Whether this template supports dynamic replacements (Handlebars): `legacy` or `dynamic`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The template's UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) The time this template was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sendgrid_template.welcome_email <template_id>
```
